text: A session defaults to "moss-minilm" when you pass no model_id (other options: "moss-mediumlm" or "custom"). The exception is when it loads an existing cloud index or disk snapshot: it then takes that index/snapshots stored model (in Python/Elixir, omit model_id when resuming to adopt it; passing a different one raises ValueError / :invalid_argument). session.model_id reports the model in use.
